summary.text: Janeen Sollman is a Democratic member of the Oregon State Senate for District 15, which her legislative page lists as Forest Grove, Cornelius, Hillsboro and Rock Creek.
Her page says she has lived in the district for more than 30 years and has worked for over 26 years for Vernier Science Education.

paragraphs.text: Sollman served on the Hillsboro School Board from 2009 to 2017 and continues to serve on the Career and College Pathways Steering Committee, according to her page.
She and her husband, Tony, have two grown sons and two grandchildren.
Her page lists legislative accomplishments dating to 2017, including the 2017 measure allocating $170 million to the High School Graduation and College and Career Readiness Fund (Measure 98 funding).

Later entries include a 2019 law requiring school instruction about the Holocaust and genocide, a 2019 law restricting single-use checkout bags, a 2023 bill creating a grant and loan program for semiconductor businesses, and a 2024 right-to-repair bill for consumer electronics.
